blocks.heading: Talkdesk cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Talkdesk against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Digital and Voice Essentials are channel-siloed — true omnichannel starts at Elite (list price). Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Digital and Voice Essentials are channel-siloed — true omnichannel starts at Elite (list price)

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: CXA AI (Copilot/Autopilot/Navigator) is typically add-on priced on top of CX Cloud seats

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Not a substitute for SMB business-phone / UCaaS seats

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Contracts and telephony usage commonly raise TCO beyond list floors

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Implementation and WFM complexity favour mid-market+ buyers
